mechanism: Lopinavir is a CYP3A4 inhibitor that may increase nicotine metabolism via induction of other pathways, and nicotine induces CYP1A2 which could theoretically affect lopinavir levels; combined cardiovascular effects from nicotine with protease inhibitor-related metabolic changes.
action: Monitor for increased nicotine effects and cardiovascular changes; counsel on smoking cessation; assess cardiac status regularly in patients on concurrent therapy.
